description: This file defines the TimeConfigPeriodModel class within the OrangeHRM Time API module. It represents a model used for serialization of the TimeConfigPeriod data, specifically containing a startDay property. It implements the Normalizable interface for converting to an array, which is useful for API responses.

classes.name: TimeConfigPeriodModel
classes.description: A model class that wraps a TimeConfigPeriod object and provides serialization functionality for its startDay property.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the model with a TimeConfigPeriod object.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the model to an associative array suitable for API responses, specifically exposing the startDay property.
